concerns.text: FR-001 requires validation that the downloaded Omni‑Doc‑1 dataset contains the required 'text‑only' and 'image‑only' label keys, but no task performs this validation; T006 only downloads the subset and writes a parquet file.

FR-002 mandates loading the Qwen‑Image‑VAE‑2.0 model in CPU‑only mode. T008 treats the tiny‑vae model as the primary loader (fallback only if Qwen fails), effectively weakening the requirement to a different model.

Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires every artifact to have a recorded content hash and updates to the project state YAML. No task creates or updates an `artifact_hashes` map, nor writes the required `state/projects/...yaml` file, violating the constitution.
